thread.document:
Executive Summary:

I prompted DeepSeek to answer the coding questions from Homework 4. Asking questions both to respond to the coding sections as answer the conceptual questions, I found that in terms of technical correctness, DeepSeek did extremely well, particularly on the coding parts. But in conceptual depth about the coding questions, explanations were not always the best.

Overall, it seems, DeepSeek is good at execution but weaker at interpretation.

Q5: This was just designing two filters/convolution, so the fact that it one-shotted the code with little explanation is not suprising



Q6: This problem was much more involved with a lot more coding, and importantly, conceptual questions
